title: Story card
description: One story card in data/story/<id>.json (S1-S4): one or two sentences in the game's tone, shown at a fixed moment of the run. Templated names ({yokai}, {move}) are filled from the player's run (S4); every placeholder used in title or text must be listed in placeholders, and every listed one used.

noEmoji.description: No emoji, regional-indicator flags, zero-width joiners or variation selectors: Godot 4.7.2's text server crashes on Linux shaping long runs of them (YOK-109). Combining marks are checked by tools/validate_data.py after NFC normalisation, so precomposed accents (ō, é) stay allowed.

trigger.description: When the card shows (the S3 schedule entry it implements).

title.description: Optional heading shown above the text.

text.description: One or two sentences (S2). Elder-twist intro cards (id ending in -intro) are capped at 260 characters: the hanging scroll shows the quote whole (YOK-109).

placeholders.description: Run names the game fills in (S4): {yokai} = the yokai's display name, {move} = the copy target's move name.

speaker.description: Who says it, e.g. Ryo, narrator, Master Soen, Tanuki.
